arms.B_full: k=400 x league, all four cells = exp_024 arm B

conversion.sensitivity: brier 1e-6 = score 0.4003; a 6-decimal Brier carries +-0.2002 in the converted number

leak_boundary.tables: row of season s uses seasons <= s-1 only; verified at runtime inside backoff.py/dev_k.py and again here by an independent re-read of train.csv
leak_boundary.beta_fit: supply blocks 2022+2023 of the same seed, on that arm's own d; the probe reuses B_full's beta unchanged
leak_boundary.arm_choice: the three arms are fixed by config.yaml before any 2024 number is read; the ablation is not chosen by looking at 2024
leak_boundary.vintage_probe: <=2022 is strictly MORE PAST than the <=2023 table fold_2024 normally uses, so it cannot leak; it is a diagnostic and changes no arm
leak_boundary.design_matrix: unchanged — no deviation is ever a model feature
leak_boundary.missing: no sentinel fill anywhere; L=0 means 'apply no correction', which is the behaviour without the module
